Yes, that fallback covers exactly the worry I had. I typed "REFERENCE" in all caps, ignored the suggestion popup entirely, and just hit Add label — and it still landed as my existing lowercase **reference**, not a new "REFERENCE" sitting alongside it. It even told me it reused the established spelling, which is a nice touch so I understand what happened.

That's the important safety net. The suggestion dropdown is great when I notice it, but I won't always — I'll be typing quickly and hit Add without looking. Knowing that even then it recognizes "this is really the label you already have, just typed differently" and folds it into the one I've got is exactly what stops me ending up with three slightly-different versions of the same label. So yes, this prevents the accidental duplication I was concerned about. Good.
